Results.ReviewText: The Weber Q1200 gas grill is without doubt the best grill I've ever had. Many years ago I had a Weber table top charcoal grill, and later had a bigger one. Then probably 20 years ago I switched to propane and have had three or four brands other than Weber. They didn't last long and did not cook nearly as evenly as the Q1200. I've had it for a coupe months now and have used it at least two dozen times. Everything from steak to pork loin to chicken and various vegatables have turned out really well. I especially like the temperature gauge and the electronic ignition. The cooking guide that came with the grill is really helpful. Finally, it's small enough to carry with us when we are camping in our motorhome. It's plenty big for  two people and no doubt a few more.
Results.Title: Best grill I've ever owned

Results.ReviewText: I absolutely LOVE my Weber Q1200 Gas Grill!!!  I have been trying to convince my hubby that I wanted to buy a small gas grill for our new home (2 years we built a small house).  Finally with my 73 birthday coming up (end of May) he agreed that we could get one.  His only requirement was it used a small propane canister (like the ones we use to use on old camp stoves) because we're in our 70's and the big tanks are too heavy for us to lift.  I love everything about this bbq.  It was easy to put together.  I love the electronic started button.  All of the food I have cooked have come out fantastic (last night it was swordfish steak and grilled squash).  My only suggestion is you buy extra propane canisters just in case you run out in the middle of cooking something.  I give it an A+.
Results.Title: The BEST birthday present ever!!!

Results.ReviewText: Got the q1200 just one week ago and have used it every day using the one lb. cylinder.  Fish, shrimp ( bought from the boat) hamburgers, all worked well.  Hoping now that I’ve switched to the 20 lb.  cylinder it will get hotter than the 450 degrees for charing.  Very portable with the smaller cylinders. Love it!

Results.ReviewText:
The Grill does a great job barbequing meat & vegetables and is a perfect size for preparing meals for our family of four. It is also easy to bring along on car camping trips or weekend getaways. 
The only complaint we have is with the stand that we bought with the grill. When we need to move the grill and use the extending handle on the stand to lift the grill/stand and roll it on the wheels, the whole stand tends to try to flip over. It is easier to just take the Grill off the stand and move the two separately.
If you have a table or raised area you plan to dedicate to placing the grill on while using it, I would recommend not buying the stand.

Results.ReviewText:
I have had lots of grills in the past - both large and small.  All of my big grills always, rusted, rotted, etc, do 5 years ago I finally spent more $$$ on a Weber Genesis 330 grill....it has been fabulous and still in perfect shape.

I needed an additional grill for occasional, portable use.  Since I loved the quality of my Genesis, looking at the Weber Q1200 and Q2200 was a no brainer.  I ended up selecting the Q1200 because it was a little smaller.  I also purchased the griddle, cart and bought an 11lb propane bottle and an LP tank connector.

When I received it, I thought it was going to be too small.  My first use was a small company picnic gathering.  The Q1200 was PERFECT!!!!  I put 24 hotdogs on the grill all the way out to all of the edges.  The heat distribution is perfectly even, no hot spots or cold spots.  ALL 24 hotdogs cooked at an identical speed and all were finished at the exact same time.

Since then, I now use it as my main grill at home and prefer it over my larger Weber Genesis 330.  I am usually only cooking for 2-6 people.  Because it cooks so evenly, you can use the ENTIRE grate surface and I can easily get 10 hamburger patties or 6 steaks or 2 London Broils on the grill.  All have cooked perfectly.

Because the grates are small, cleanup is a breeze.  I simply take them inside, clean them in the kitchen sink and put them in the dishwasher.  I haven’t tried the griddle yet, but I will on my next camping trip and am confident that it will work flawlessly for fixing breakfast.

Absolutely love it - no regrets or complaints!!!
Results.Title: PERFECT small grill, even heat distribution.

Results.ReviewText: I did my research and decided on the Weber Q 1200. We have used it at the house for steaks and chicken. Taking it car camping this upcoming weekend.
